speaker: Doctor
text: Given the knee pain and limp in a 7-year-old without trauma, I suspect referred pain from the hip. REQUEST TEST: Hip_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Flattening and fragmentation of the left femoral head consistent with Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease

speaker: Doctor
